question: Under what condition should a teacher confer the teaching that grants long life?
premises: The recipient must be thoroughly examined.
This examination should be done carefully.
Only then may the giver bestow what grants long life.
inference: After thorough examination, the teacher may give the teaching that confers long life.
uncertainties: Whether cirajīvitam refers literally to long life or to enduring spiritual vitality is unclear.
plain_english: Having always examined him well, one may give to him that which grants long life.
